# RAR — the one store for RAPP (agents, packs, senses, pages, rapplications)

> Start here if you are an AI: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/RAPP.md (the one page: rapp/1, agents, packs, lifecycle, how to participate).
> Install for a person from any AI (GitHub Copilot Agent mode by default): the RAPP skill https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/skills/rar-easy-mode/SKILL.md — they say "Show me RAR" or "Give me <names> using RAR Easy Mode and test it for me".

- Catalog (JSON): https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/registry.json
- Agent tickets: rewrite https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/#agent/@pub/name to https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/a/@pub/name/agent.md and fetch it for the agent and the three load steps (no JavaScript required).
- Packs and starters (one cart): https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/distros.html
- Write a layer (contract, file-generated parts/proven engines, add/check/remove): https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/LAYERS.md
- Agent template: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/template_agent.py
- Install anything: curl -fsSL https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/add.sh | bash -s -- <pack or @publisher/agent> ...
- Protocol: https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/llms.txt

## Static API descriptor and deterministic content store
- Descriptor: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/manifest.json (rapp-static-api/1.1).
- Build everything offline: `python3 build_registry.py`. Inputs include agent manifests, stack packs and marketplace metadata. `--registry-only` retains the low-level registry build for isolated tooling.
- The descriptor exposes Pages URLs alongside all existing raw URLs. Browser transport and authenticated capabilities remain unchanged.
- Every registry agent has `_version` with a SHA-256, 12-character `sha8`, and immutable `versions/<name>/<sha8><ext>` path. Verify the downloaded bytes before loading.
- Status endpoint hashes cover the exact served JSON bytes and include `version_path`: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/api/v1/status.json.
- Frames are append-only. A changed input adds a frame; an existing frame is never deleted or overwritten, and a collision or corrupted frame fails the build.
- Timestamps come from git commit time (or explicit `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` for exported inputs); unchanged documents keep their input timestamp. Rebuilds are byte-identical.
- Full rapp-static-api/1.1 conformance is pending Kody's decision on existing browser GitHub API calls, cache bypasses and workflow concurrency. No browser feature is removed to clear lint.

## Endpoints for AIs
- Guide (install packs and agents for your person, test them): https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/skills/rar-easy-mode/SKILL.md
- Any agent, as plain text with load steps: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/a/{publisher}/{name}/agent.md
- Catalog: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/registry.json · agents: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/api/v1/index.json · skills: https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/api/v1/skills.json
- A running Brainstem with the ticket-page pack explains itself at GET http://localhost:7071/api/ticket
